question: Which of the following is an advantage of vegetative propagation?

options.text: Plants grown this way take longer to bear fruits.
All new plants are genetically different from the parent.
It allows propagation of seedless plants such as banana.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It allows propagation of seedless plants such as banana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vegetative propagation** is a method of plant reproduction that occurs through vegetative parts of the plant such as roots, stems, or leaves, without involving seeds.
 
• This technique is particularly beneficial for plants like **bananas, sugarcane, and potatoes**, which are seedless or have seeds that are not viable for propagation.
 
• Since vegetative propagation produces **genetically identical plants** to the parent, it helps maintain desirable traits such as taste, size, and disease resistance.
 
• It is a **faster method of reproduction** compared to growing plants from seeds, as it skips the germination phase and directly establishes a mature plant.
 
• Vegetative propagation is widely used in **horticulture and agriculture** for commercial cultivation of high-yield or disease-resistant varieties.
